capacity_usable_kwh.notes: 62 kWh gross pack has 58 kWh usable (VW figure relayed by SlashGear 2023; ArenaEV 2024 lists 58 usable).

chemistry.notes: Estimated, weak guess (OWNER FLAG): no page found states the 62 kWh pack chemistry (The Weekly Driver and Guide Auto say only lithium-ion; one EV Database listing for a later 58 kWh usable ID.4 shows LFP). nmc is assumed because thinkEV lists NMC for the 82 kWh MEB pack and Wikipedia says both packs use 24-cell modules; this is a different pack, so verify before trusting.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Canadian 2025 Base page lists 62.0 kWh at 400 V; ArenaEV calls the 2024 Standard pack "400V type". Same MEB pack all years.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs says ID.4/ID.5 built 2020-2024 had no battery preconditioning (automatic only from 2024); software 3.9.1 (electrive: built before Oct 2023, needs 3.7+) adds only a manual button and no page says it reached US/Canadian cars; if it did, this car would be manual_only. Late-2023 builds may differ. European-sourced (InsideEVs/electrive name no market); a second look at VW US/Canada pages, US press and software-update coverage found no North American statement. Low confidence; owner to accept or verify.

dc_max_kw.notes: SlashGear: 62 kWh pack peaks at 140 kW; ArenaEV and Wikipedia agree.

ac_max_kw.notes: 11 kW onboard charger (VW 2021 launch release relayed by ConceptCarz; SlashGear 2023: 11 kW on both packs; vw.com 2026 page: up to 11 kW home charging).
